display.purpose: Key metric numbers — volume totals, PRs, large rep counts. Paired below with a Space Grotesk label.

subtitle.purpose: Sub-headers, exercise names in workout lists.

body.purpose: General content, list rows, form labels.

label.purpose: Navigation labels, metric sub-labels, section headers. Always Space Grotesk. Never Lexend.

shadows.name: sheet-float
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets and modals only. Never on cards.

shadows.name: ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: Dragging/pressed state on draggable list items. Disappears on release.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest anchor on any screen. Amber fill, void text, 20px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F59E0B; color: #0B0E1A; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); letter-spacing: 0; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #D97706; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F59E0B; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #B45309; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Secondary / destructive actions. No background, no border. Text only.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { background: none; color: #E8E8E8; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; padding: 14px 16px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-text:hover { color: #F59E0B; } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F59E0B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Filled, no border at rest. Surface-raised fill, amber 1px focus stroke.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-input { background: #141928; color: #E8E8E8; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); line-height: 1.5; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5A6880; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #F59E0B; }

components.name: Card (default)
components.description: Standard data card. Surface-card bg, surface-high border, 16px radius.
components.html:
BENCH PRESS
120kg
3 sets — last week
components.css: .ds-card { background: #111827; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #1C2235; } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #8896B0; margin-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-metric { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 56px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 0.94; letter-spacing: -1.5px; color: #E8E8E8; display: inline; } .ds-card-unit { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.2px; color: #8896B0; margin-left: 4px; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: #5A6880; margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Chip (accent)
components.description: Active filter or selected muscle group. Amber tint bg, amber text.
components.css: .ds-chip-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(245,158,11,0.13); color: #F59E0B; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.5px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Chip (rest)
components.description: Inactive filter or tag. Surface-high bg, secondary text.
components.css: .ds-chip-rest { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #1C2235; color: #8896B0; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.5px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Bottom Sheet
components.description: Preferred modal pattern. 24px top radius, drag handle, sheet-float shadow.
components.html:
Choose Workout Type
Sheet content goes here.

components.description: Bottom nav item — active state. Amber icon and label.

components.name: Logotype
components.description: GYMLOG wordmark — fixed spec, never altered. Amber in both light and dark mode.
components.css: .ds-logotype { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; font-style: italic; letter-spacing: 3px; color: #F59E0B; }

narrative.overview:
GymLog is a high-precision instrument for athletes who track their training with the same rigor they bring to the gym. The visual system is built around a single constraint: legibility in any gym condition — bright overhead fluorescents, dim locker room, one-handed between sets. The answer is obsidian surfaces, amber signal, and typography that reads in a glance.

The system rejects decoration on principle. Every visual element either carries information or supports something that does. The deep navy-black backgrounds (#0B0E1A) are not dark mode for aesthetics — they reduce glare under fluorescents and make the amber accent impossible to miss. That amber (#F59E0B) is used with surgical precision: primary action, live session indicator, the logotype wordmark. Nothing else.

This system explicitly rejects: bright consumer fitness aesthetics, generic SaaS dashboard layouts, anatomy-textbook muscle maps with rainbow fills and callout lines, and anything that reads as AI-generated fitness app from a stock template.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian surface stack: four tonal layers from #0B0E1A to #1C2235
Amber as the single accent — ≤10% of any screen
Lexend + Space Grotesk type system; negative letter-spacing on all headlines
Precision-ground corners: 12–16px on content containers, 20px on primary actions
Flat app bars — elevation 0, scroll-under elevation 0 — always
No colored border stripes; borders only define surface boundaries

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber (#F59E0B) appears on ≤10% of any screen. Its scarcity is the signal. If amber appears in more than one distinct role on a screen, one of those uses is wrong.

rules.name: The Light Mode Inversion Rule
rules.body: In light mode, amber is replaced by #111111 as the general accent. The GYMLOG logotype remains amber in both modes — it is the only element that keeps amber in light mode.

rules.name: The Negative Tracking Rule
rules.body: All Lexend headlines and display text carry negative letter-spacing (-0.2sp minimum, -1.5sp for display numerics).

rules.name: The No-Scale-Mixing Rule
rules.body: Labels are always Space Grotesk. Headlines, titles, body are always Lexend. Never mix within a single text element.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a darker or lighter surface value before reaching for a shadow. Shadows mean 'this is floating.' Tonal steps mean 'this is on top.'

dos: Do use surface-void (#0B0E1A) as the scaffold base — never a lighter surface as the bottom layer.
Do convey depth through tonal layering. Shadows are for floating elements only.
Do keep amber on ≤10% of any screen.
Do apply negative letter-spacing to all Lexend headlines.
Do use filled inputs with surface-raised and no stroke at rest.
Do use Space Grotesk exclusively for labels, nav items, and metadata.
Do keep the GYMLOG logotype in Lexend w900 italic, amber, letter-spacing 3sp — in both modes.
Do use the Sheet Float shadow exclusively on bottom sheets and modals.
donts: Don't use bright consumer fitness aesthetics: no saturated teals, neon, pinks, or motivational gradient fills.
Don't use the generic SaaS dashboard pattern: big metric number, small label, stat grid, gradient accent card.
Don't apply a colored border-left or border-right stripe to cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient). Amber is a solid color.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Surfaces are solid obsidian.
Don't render muscle maps with rainbow region fills or callout label lines. Amber glow is the data channel.
Don't add shadows to cards or list items at rest.
Don't use amber in more than one distinct role on a screen without strong justification.
Don't produce a screen that reads as AI-generated fitness app from a stock template.
